approval.note: A 3 m clinker rowing boat drawn up on the shingle, dry, built from the gunwale outward: the gunwale the widest line, a stem post and a transom; under the white sheer strake the south side's lapped strakes, blue, then red below the waterline with weed along it; frames, floor boards, two thwarts and an oar inside; a stone chocked under the forefoot.

requires.note: drawn up the beach above the tide line

audit.size_class: rowing_boat (a 3 m clinker boat, 1.3 m in the beam, 0.6 m to its gunwale, its stern turned a little to us; art px: 62 to 76 tall, 124 to 140 wide)
audit.eastward_ref: 17 (the churns and the farm props for painted metal and rope), 12 (the post box for a painted iron body); no harbour in the local refs
